Name: Jehoiada, Son of Benaiah
Summary: Son of Benaiah, counsellor after Ahithophel, with Abiathar.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 27:34: Son of Benaiah, counsellor after Ahithophel, with Abiathar.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Jehoiada stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
